featured_reviews.review_text:
I am extremely disappointed with my experience with Wooden Street.

My name is Mohammed Basheer Shaikh, and I placed an order on 6th March 2026 for multiple items including a queen-size hydraulic bed, sofa-cum-bed, mattress, pillows, and cushion covers with fillers. At the time of purchase, I was clearly promised delivery within 30 days, and I was required to make 100% advance payment, which I did in good faith.

Unfortunately, the company failed to honor their commitment. Even after nearly 50 days, only the bed and one sofa were delivered. The delay itself was unacceptable, but what made matters worse was the poor product quality compared to what was shown at the time of purchase. Due to this, I requested cancellation of one sofa-cum-bed.

After repeated follow-ups and considerable effort, they finally agreed to the cancellation. However, instead of refunding my money back to the original payment method, they forcibly credited the amount into their Wooden Street wallet. This is completely unacceptable. As a customer who paid via credit card, I expect a refund through the original mode of payment or a valid alternative like bank transfer—not store credit with limitations and validity.

To date (1st May 2026), some items like cushions are still pending delivery. The delays are ongoing, and there is no transparency or accountability.

Customer support has been equally frustrating. Calls are rarely handled properly, responses are vague, and most queries are met with standard replies like “we will get back in 24–48 hours,” but no actual resolution is provided. The staff often come across as uncooperative and indifferent to customer concerns.

This entire experience has been mentally exhausting and feels like customer harassment. Blocking customer funds in a wallet system without consent, failing to deliver on time, and providing subpar service reflects very poorly on the company’s ethics and professionalism.

I strongly advise others to be cautious before purchasing from Wooden Street. If you still choose to proceed, do not make full advance payment, as the company’s responsiveness drastically declines after receiving the money.

This has been one of the worst purchasing experiences I have ever had.
